bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 6 to 8 ft this morning, increasing to around 8 to 10 ft late tonight through Monday Bar conditions light becoming rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 200 AM Sunday, 230 PM Sunday, and 300 AM Monday. The Sunday afternoon ebb will be strong.
